findings.title: job_params mapped to changelistcreate_params - SDK-specific field name
findings.description: In start_job, user-provided job_params are mapped to the SDK field changelistcreate_params. This field name is specific to the OneFS isilon_sdk's JobJobCreateParams model. The OneFS SDK maps different job-type-specific parameters through this single field. This is consistent with how the SDK is designed, but the limitation should be documented for users who may need custom parameters for non-ChangelistCreate job types.
findings.expected_behavior: Documentation should note that job_params is passed through the SDK's changelistcreate_params field.
findings.actual_behavior: The mapping works correctly for job types that support custom parameters through the SDK's CreateParams model.

findings.title: PowerScaleBase.job_api property added as foundation for future module refactoring
findings.description: The job_api property was added to PowerScaleBase per the Implementation Plan (Phase 1: Foundation). The 6 new modules inherit from object (following the existing synciqjob.py pattern) rather than PowerScaleBase. The property is available for future module refactoring when modules are migrated to the PowerScaleBase pattern.
findings.expected_behavior: Property available for future use when modules are refactored to use PowerScaleBase.
findings.actual_behavior: Property exists but is not currently referenced by the new modules.
